does_not_close: Does not flip the target receipt's H0_REFUTED verdict on generator-vs-commercial-envelope coverage -- that scientific conclusion is corroborated, not overturned.

Does not modify, supersede, or delete the target receipt or its reference file; this is a companion audit finding only. A formal repair (R-*) would be needed to correct the target receipt's numeric claims.

18 of the 25 cure_verification_set.json hardener rows have null AHEW (not extracted from the cited TDS by that dataset's own authors); the true floor could be lower still if those were resolved -- not attempted here.
AHEW anchors remain technical-grade measured values on polydisperse resins; the comparison still bounds capability, not product equivalence.
Not a cure-kinetics, pot-life, property, FTO, or wet-lab performance claim.
headline: The signed molgen-stoichiometric-envelope-coverage-v1 receipt's anchor population (commercial_envelope_g_per_eq=[100,264], n_commercial_anchors=6) is INCOMPLETE relative to its own stated population ('commercial marine epoxy-amine hardeners already shipped in amphora-ingredient-library'): cure_verification_set.json (sha256 884356a094bd6f4d...), byte-identical in both amphora-ingredient-library and this module's own reference/mvp20/data/ and listed in this module's own mission.md as a checked dataset, carries 7 dual-source-provenanced named-hardener AHEW facts, 4 of which (ancamide_2426, ancamide_805, ancamide_2050, ancamide_910) are absent from the target receipt's 6-anchor list. The lowest, Ancamide 2426 at 93 g/eq (EMEA guide), sits BELOW the target's claimed commercial floor of 100 g/eq, so the true floor is 93 g/eq, not 100, and the true anchor count is 10, not 6. The target's headline shortfall figures (37.9232 g/eq, 0.3792 fraction) are stale under the corrected population (true shortfall 30.9232 g/eq, 0.3325 fraction). The 3 products present in both files (ancamide_2353, ancamide_260a, ancamide_350a) agree exactly (cross-file consistency check PASS), confirming cure_verification_set.json is reliable, non-circular data, not noise. This does NOT flip the underlying H0 verdict itself: even the corrected floor (93 g/eq) remains above the independently re-derived generated hull ceiling (62.0768 g/eq), so 0 anchors fall inside the hull under either population and the generator-cannot-reach-commercial-band scientific conclusion survives. What is refuted is the target receipt's specific, signed, quantitative claim that its 6-anchor facts.json-only enumeration is the complete relevant commercial population and that 100 g/eq is the true commercial floor.

hypothesis_evaluation.decision_rule: H0 is refuted if a second already-in-tree, hash-pinned, cross-module-identical dataset in the SAME population scope contains named-hardener AHEW facts absent from the target's anchor list, OR if it shifts the claimed commercial floor.
hypothesis_evaluation.does_not_flip: The target receipt's headline scientific hypothesis_evaluation.verdict (H0_REFUTED -- generator does not cover the commercial stoichiometric envelope) remains correct under the corrected, larger anchor population. Only the target's specific signed numeric claims about anchor-set size, envelope floor, and shortfall magnitude are stale/incomplete.
hypothesis_evaluation.evidence: cure_verification_set.json contributes 4 named anchors absent from the target's list; Ancamide 2426 (AHEW=93 g/eq) undercuts the claimed floor of 100 g/eq. Does NOT flip the target's underlying scientific conclusion (generator cannot reach commercial AHEW band) -- the corrected floor is still 30.923 g/eq above the generated hull ceiling.
hypothesis_evaluation.h0: The target receipt's 6-anchor commercial_envelope_g_per_eq=[100.0,264.0] and n_commercial_anchors=6 constitute the complete population of named commercial marine epoxy-amine hardener AHEW facts already shipped in amphora-ingredient-library, as the target receipt's own purpose field claims.

non_circularity: Grammar SMILES re-read from the same hash-locked grammar-yield diagnostic the target receipt used; AHEW is independently re-derived here from structure by RDKit (same active-N-H convention as the target and this module's R-A06v2 repair). The anchor union is a plain set union over two files already checked into this module's own reference directory (facts.json, cure_verification_set.json); no external data fetched, no new data acquired.
purpose: Audit whether the signed molgen-stoichiometric-envelope-coverage-v1 receipt's 6-anchor 'commercial envelope' population is complete relative to its own stated scope, by unioning it against a second, already-checked-in, hash-identical dataset (cure_verification_set.json) present in the SAME reference/mvp20/data/ directory of the SAME module and explicitly listed in this module's own mission.md.

rights_posture.commercial_anchor_basis: numeric scalars already shipped in-tree in both amphora-ingredient-library and amphora-molecule-generator reference/mvp20/data/; no new source touched
